name: Sunray Bristol Bay 4-Person Indoor Infrared Corner Sauna 400KC
description: Description The SunRay Bristol Bay 4-Person Corner Infrared Sauna is designed with bench seating on each side to comfortably fit four people. It uses 10 advanced carbon-nano heaters to quickly reach temperatures up to 140°F while maintaining low EMF levels. The sauna is made from Canadian red cedar and includes movable ergonomic backrests, chromatherapy lighting, a Bluetooth speaker system, an oxygen ionization system for air purification, and dual digital keypads for easy operation. ETL/CSA certified and simple to assemble, the Bristol Bay provides a reliable indoor sauna experience.
